properties.name: Proclamation Line of 1763
sources: Royal Proclamation of 1763: settlement barred beyond 'the heads or sources of any of the rivers which fall into the Atlantic Ocean from the west and northwest'; drawn along the Eastern Continental Divide (Georgia to Pennsylvania). Superseded in part by the Treaties of Hard Labour and Fort Stanwix (1768).

review.notes: Seed for the u3e1 sample. Northern end (New York) not drawn; extend from a period map before approving.
